Sam H: Heads-up: scheduled external pen test Thu May 9 09:00-13:00 PT. We need RBAC snapshot, KMS access plan, filtered audit log export, vuln triage owner, and retest slots. Can we lock a 2h readroom Wed 10-12 PT? @Lia P @Jordan C
Lia P: Wed 10-12 PT works for Security. Which envs are in-scope? staging only?
Jordan C: Staging active exploit validation. We can provide sanitized prod audit logs (no key material). Will provide presigned S3 link for last 7 days of events.
Kevin S: KMS note: rotate staging CMK Tue 02:00 PT to ensure fresh key material. We'll use STS ephemeral roles, duration 3600s. Sample assume-role policy to restrict kms:Decrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey.
Sam H: Devex: please run `rbac-export --since 2023-01-01 --format csv` and include service->role->last_modified. Mask any PII fields.
Lia P: I'll attach export and a shortlist of admin actions to include in audit filter: `AssumeRole`, `CreatePolicy`, `AttachRolePolicy`, `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:GenerateDataKey`.
assessor-bot: Assessment created: ASSESS-2024-0412. Upload evidence to presigned bucket: https://s3-presigned.example/ASSESS-2024-0412 (expires in 7d)
Jordan C: I'll lead vuln triage. We'll track in JIRA epic RED-PT-2024 and label PRs `pt-remediate`. Triage table should be CVE, component, risk, repro, owner, ETA.
Kevin S: FYI rotation may cause ~30s decrypt errors; scheduling at 02:00 reduces user impact. I'll create the ephemeral role and post role ARN + trust policy.
Lia P: Proposed retest slots: Mon 09:00-11:00 PT and Thu 14:00-16:00 PT next week. Assessor availability?
assessor-bot: Assessor availability: Mon OK, Thu tentative.
Sam H: Action items: Lia export RBAC + audit filter by EOD; Kevin schedule KMS rotation + create ephemeral role; Jordan own triage in RED-PT-2024; I'll confirm readroom and presigned bucket and publish runbook tomorrow. Objections?
Kevin S: lgtm :thumbsup:
Lia P: lgtm
Jordan C: lgtm
Sam H: thanks — tagging @security-oncall to be aware.
